items.caption:
Recurring dreams meaning: what science says.
In a 2006 study of 212 recurrent dreams, about two thirds contained a threat, but under 2% fit every prediction of threat rehearsal theory. A hypothesis tested, not settled.

items.caption:
Every night, your brain paralyses you.
In REM sleep the brainstem switches off most voluntary muscles so you do not act out your dreams; eye and breathing muscles keep working.
